title: Medtrum: Priming screen returns to Change Patch screen
symptom: When starting priming, the screen immediately returns to the Change Patch screen, with a very short failure message not shown on overview. The process of reading activation status never finishes. This can happen multiple times, sometimes leading to patch discard.
cause: The thread suggests a possible timeout in the script when taking too long to apply the patch, and also a possible misunderstanding between the driver and the patch. One user found that running the 'Security' app's 'Boost speed' before patch change prevents the issue, implying a performance-related cause.
fix: The user dar-kod found that running the 'Security' application's 'Boost speed' before patch change prevents the problem. Another user suggests having everything ready before starting the process to avoid timeout.
evidence_quote: I have an old Poco F3 with HyperOS, Android 13. It has an application called "Security". If this application is started before the patch change and you run "Boost speed", this problem does not occur at all.
